dog.description_text:
🐶 Indie | Female | 12 Weeks Old
🐾 Doxie Mix | 7.6 Pounds
Meet Indie, a smart, playful little sweetheart who is ready to steal your heart! ❤️
🧠 SMART COOKIE ALERT! Indie figured out how to use the doggie door in just 24 HOURS! This clever girl is already showing off her puppy skills!
🌙 SWEET DREAMS! Indie sleeps well through the night and does a great job taking care of business when taken outside regularly!
📺 NETFLIX & SNUGGLES? YES, PLEASE! When she's not busy playing, Indie loves nothing more than cuddling up beside you to watch TV. She's the perfect little couch companion! 🥰
🎶 A LITTLE MUSIC & RELAXATION! Indie enjoys listening to her relaxing music when she's left at home for a few hours. And did we mention she LOVES her snacks? 🦴❤️
🐾 PLAYTIME IS THE BEST TIME! Indie absolutely loves chasing her sister through the house and yard. She's full of puppy energy, curiosity, and personality!
💕 Indie has the perfect combination of brains, playfulness, and cuddles! All she's missing is a forever family to share them with!
dog.name: Indie
